description: This Java class manages JWT-based authentication within the OFBiz framework, handling token creation, validation, and integration with OFBiz's security and session management, specifically for single sign-on via JWT tokens.

classes.name: JWTManager
classes.description: This class manages JWT creation, validation, and session integration for OFBiz, including external JWK provider handling and token verification.

methods.name: checkJWTLogin
methods.description: OFBiz controller post-processor to verify JWT token in incoming requests for SSO and set user login session.

methods.name: getAuthenticationToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token after successful user authentication via username/password.

methods.name: getHeaderAuthBearerToken
methods.description: Extracts the JWT token from the 'Authorization' header if it follows 'Bearer <token>' format.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates a JWT token using either external JWK or local secret key, returning claims or error.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Overloaded method that validates a token without specifying key salt, defaults to internal validation.

methods.name: createJwt
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with given claims and default expiration.

methods.name: createJwt
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with given claims and specified expiration time.

methods.name: createJwt
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with claims, optional salt, and specified expiration time.

methods.name: checkTenant
methods.description: Verifies tenant consistency for multi-tenant setups, updating context if needed.

methods.name: storeUserlogin
methods.description: Stores or updates the user login session info in the database.

methods.name: getUserlogin
methods.description: Retrieves user login info from the database based on JWT claims.

methods.name: validateJwtToken
methods.description: Performs token validation and logs issues, returning validated claims or error.

methods.name: createRefreshToken
methods.description: Generates a refresh JWT token for the specified user login ID.

methods.name: validateRefreshToken
methods.description: Validates a refresh token and ensures it is of type 'refresh'.
